headline: A scan that is two and a half times faster, remove the spare copies, and fold the panel down to the list.
notes: Scanning is 2.5x faster on a big project. The walk asked the host ten questions one after another about every clip on every timeline; it asks them all at once now, which on 5,776 clips is nine fewer round trips each.

Remove spare copies — a clip imported twice is one file and several project items. Trace+ keeps one and removes the rest, and refuses on anything used in a cut or on a subclip with its own in and out points.
Every row says what it is: VIDEO, AUDIO, STILL, NEST or MULTICAM, in its own colour, and OFFLINE in red. The same filters now work inside a single sequence.
Tick boxes on every clip row, so selecting a long list no longer means scrolling to the bottom to find Select all.
Put back is reliable — it used to move some clips and quietly skip others. It now says what it could not move and why.
Much faster scanning on a big project. One probe was running twice per duplicate on every redraw; a 73-duplicate project was making 146 host calls it did not need.
Fold it down: the summary block, the filter rows and every section heading in the project view collapse, and the panel says what is still filtering when the chips are hidden.
The scan report has Copy and Hide buttons of its own, and Copy is in the ☰ menu too.
